method: Compiled public demo with genuine mouse and CDP touch input; isolated bundle of actual shared slider and real rating wrapper for disabled/auth/submit props only. No Firebase initialization.

checks.name: Direct control has no separate range bar, null stays unrated on focus, native keyboard semantics retained
Mouse clicks map each star left/right half to exact half steps with minimum1 and decorative half fill
Captured mouse dragging clamps outside strip and releases cleanly; secondary button does not change selection
Direct-star selection still requires explicit demo Submit, Remove restores unrated and ownership examples stay intact
Actual touch tap/drag selects halves without page scrolling; touch cancellation leaves no stuck drag
320/390px direct-star strip fits with44px height and clear focus/value; no separate track appears
Actual real rating wrapper preserves auth gate, disabled pointer/keyboard lock and explicit Submit/Remove with shared star control

limitations: Real Firebase persistence was deliberately not repeated; prior half-star emulator evidence covers unchanged backend. Real-wrapper check uses actual component source in an isolated props harness, not a logged-in production account.
visualReview: Inspected320/390px captures: five large stars are the interaction target, the fifth star shows a half fill at4.5, the number and explicit Submit are clear, and no separate bar or thumb is visible. No identity information appears.
